defects.duplicateService: The design adds a new ThrottleService for per-API-key rate limiting, duplicating the existing RateLimiter (src/services/rate-limiter.ts, listed in docs/SERVICE_INVENTORY.md) instead of reusing it.
defects.apiContract: The design does not specify the export endpoint's API contract: its response status codes, error responses (for example when rate-limited or unauthorised) or response format.
